![Title logo (Deo's Portal Gun Mod)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfad6fa8994e76809f9e30a8166d4fce9263dc24.png)
# Deo's Portal Gun Mod
This is a mod heavily based off the Portal Travel from Rick and Morty. Do not worry! More fandoms shall be added over time! This will be the begnining of a long project!

# About the mod
This mod adds various portal guns to the game, which allow you to travel to places.

![Screenshot of all items currently in the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/862279cb7e38d55e3d27dea4446593424018b832.png)

## Features
- Survival friendly
- Works in multiplayer
- Works on modded dimensions
- Many portal guns to choose from

## Using the Portal Gun
Crouch and click to set the coordinates and dimension, and then click to spawn a portal.

![Portal Gun GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32a1f0e81a2abe3434e6212852db416a6d8b6db0.png)

![Screenshot of a portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88de260ba4153cdf86b43d5d7d5d9ed290918c3f.png)

## Obtaining a portal gun
Portal guns can be crafted with four **Iron Blocks**, a **Portal Fluid Vial**, a **Dimension Module** and **Location Module**, an **Echo Shard**, and a **Nether Star**.

![Portal gun crafting recipe: Four Iron blocks in the corners, Portal Fluid Vial on the top, Dimension Module on the left, Location module on the right, Echo Shard on the bottom, and Nether Star in the middle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85777a82f477983db8664c8ab57ab43178a72ee7.png)

![Location module recipe: Four iron blocks in the corners, Eye of enders on the left and right, Redstone Block on the top, Blaze Rod on the bottom, and a Compass in the middle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/610f7bc485e81c12a98cfead2ad096405dbabe27.png)

![Dimension Module crafting recipe: Two Iron blocks on the left and right, two Obsidian on the top and bottom, Eye of Ender in the top left, Diamond in the bottom right, two Blaze Rods in the top right and bottom left, and a Redstone Block in the middle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f4ef388310dc931a6dac8250887a9ec2f4a2d9d.png)

![Vial recipe: Four blocks of Glass](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05e49dac0e4a58600ecfeabaf217ae0e45468353.png)

![Redstone Vial recipe: Vial and Redstone Dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f183382331f3c6fdc71ca4af7148de1f28bb13cd.png)

![Incomplete Portal Fluid Vial recipe: Redstone Vial and Dragon Breath](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d8f468a5fee094dbc32edc2e375492c227ba782.png)

![Portal Fluid vial recipe: Incomplete Portal Fuild Vial and Lime Dye](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f68fdbda90d1dcef728d92ef567b3e54e2fe3bfe.png)
